## Summary

Fixes #1939 (continuation of #1860). A `solve` task launched with
`--isolation docker` inside a Docker-in-Docker host
(`konard/hive-mind-dind:2.0.2`) failed and surfaced three distinct problems.
This PR fixes the ones that live in Hive Mind code, adds debug/verbose
diagnostics so the rest is observable next iteration, reports the upstream
start-command bug, and ships a full case study.

### Root cause (Problem 3 — definite)

The native start-command (`$`) docker invocation mounted only `~/.config/gh`,
`~/.claude`, and `~/.claude.json` — **no git identity**. Inside the container
`gh` was fully authenticated (`✓ Logged in to github.com account konard`) yet
`git config user.name`/`user.email` were unset, so `solve` aborted at the
system-check stage with `❌ Git identity not configured`. "Credentials not
mounted" in the title is exactly this: the *git identity* credential never
reached the container.

```
[VERBOSE] isolation-runner: Docker isolation mounts: /home/box/.config/gh, /home/box/.claude, /home/box/.claude.json
...
❌ Git identity not configured
   user.name:  (not set)
   user.email: (not set)
```

## What changed

- **Mount the git identity for every tool** (`getDockerIsolationAuthMounts`,
  `src/isolation-runner.lib.mjs`): `~/.gitconfig` and the XDG `~/.config/git`
  are now mounted alongside `gh`, honoring `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`/`XDG_CONFIG_HOME`.
  Missing host paths are skipped. Because this lives in the shared mount builder,
  every isolation caller inherits the fix.
- **Self-healing host preflight** (`ensureHostGitIdentityForIsolation`, new):
  when the bot host has no mountable git identity it derives one from the
  authenticated `gh` account (`gh-setup-git-identity` / `repairGitIdentity`),
  else emits one actionable warning naming the exact downstream failure. Wired
  into the telegram-bot docker-isolation preflight; best-effort, never throws.
- **Pin `start-command@0.29.1`** (`Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.dind`): the upstream
  premature-status bug (Problem 1) reported as
  [link-foundation/start#136](https://github.com/link-foundation/start/issues/136)
  was **fixed and released in start-command 0.29.1** (issue closed as completed
  `2026-06-17`). Both Hive Mind images now pin that version so the fixed `$`
  binary ships, instead of installing `start-command` unpinned.
- **Cross-check premature docker status** (Problem 1, defense-in-depth):
  `isUnknownDockerExitCode` plus a docker-only cross-check in `isSessionRunning`
  and `getIsolationSessionState` keep an ambiguous `executed`/`-1` docker session
  "running" until `docker inspect` confirms the container has actually exited.
  Retained alongside the upstream fix so an older `$` on an operator's PATH
  cannot resurrect the bug. Real exit codes and non-docker backends are
  unaffected.
- **Verbose post-launch diagnostics** (Problems 1 & 2, R6):
  `logDockerIsolationPostLaunchDiagnostics` records `$ --status`, live container
  state, and local image presence after a docker launch, so the premature status
  and any image re-pull are observable from data next iteration.
- **Upstream report (R7) — resolved:** filed
  [link-foundation/start#136](https://github.com/link-foundation/start/issues/136)
  for the detached docker session that reports a terminal status (`executed`)
  with `exitCode -1` while its container is still running — with a reproducer,
  the consumer-side workaround, and a code-level fix suggestion. The maintainer
  **fixed it in start-command 0.29.1** (issue closed as completed), which this PR
  now pins in both images.

## How to reproduce

Run a `solve` task with `--isolation docker` on a host that has `gh` auth but no
`~/.gitconfig` (`user.name`/`user.email` unset). The isolated `solve` aborts
with `❌ Git identity not configured` even though `gh` is authenticated. The full
captured terminal transcript is in
[`docs/case-studies/issue-1939/raw/failed-session-terminal.log`](docs/case-studies/issue-1939/raw/failed-session-terminal.log).

## Tests

- **New:** `tests/test-issue-1939-docker-isolation.mjs` (25 assertions) — git
  identity mounted for claude+codex, env overrides, missing-identity skipped,
  `ensureHostGitIdentityForIsolation` (present / self-heal / unrepairable),
  `isUnknownDockerExitCode`, and the `getIsolationSessionState` cross-check
  (ambiguous-but-alive stays running, ambiguous-and-gone completes, real exit
  code trusted, screen backend unaffected).
- `tests/test-issue-1860-docker-isolation.mjs` (33 assertions) still passes.
- Full default suite: **all 260 test files passed**.
- `npm run lint` clean; prettier-formatted.

## Case study

[`docs/case-studies/issue-1939/README.md`](docs/case-studies/issue-1939/README.md)
— reconstructed timeline, all requirements, root cause per problem pinned to log
evidence, solution plans, alternatives considered, existing-library check, and
the upstream follow-up.

Fixes #1939

…k premature docker status (#1939)

A `--isolation docker` solve run failed at the system-check stage with
"Git identity not configured" even though gh was authenticated (account
konard). The native start-command (`$`) invocation mounted only ~/.config/gh,
~/.claude and ~/.claude.json — no git identity — so git user.name/user.email
were unset inside the container and solve aborted before any work.

Fixes (all in this PR on branch issue-1939-f81a3d54f708):

- getDockerIsolationAuthMounts now mounts the host git identity (~/.gitconfig
  and XDG ~/.config/git, honoring GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/XDG_CONFIG_HOME) for every
  tool, alongside gh. Missing host paths are skipped. (problem 3, root cause)
- ensureHostGitIdentityForIsolation (new) self-heals the bot host: when no git
  identity is mountable it derives one from the authenticated gh account via
  gh-setup-git-identity, else emits one actionable warning. Wired into the
  telegram-bot docker-isolation preflight, best-effort, never throws.
- isUnknownDockerExitCode + a docker-only cross-check in isSessionRunning and
  getIsolationSessionState keep an ambiguous "executed"/-1 docker session
  running until docker inspect confirms the container exited, so a still-running
  container is no longer reported as a finished/failed execution. (problem 1)
- logDockerIsolationPostLaunchDiagnostics (verbose) records $ --status, live
  container state and local image presence after launch so the premature status
  (problem 1) and image re-pull (problem 2) are observable next iteration.

Adds tests/test-issue-1939-docker-isolation.mjs (25 assertions) and a full case
study under docs/case-studies/issue-1939 with timeline, root-cause analysis and
captured logs. The premature-terminal-status behaviour is also reported upstream
to link-foundation/start.
